low_dense_answer_margin.note: The full-sequence answer margin is recorded only for the Oracle arm. The failure groups are not confined to low margins (largest failure-group margin = 7.5000); a low dense margin is therefore not a supported sufficient explanation of the STOP.

excessive_selection_churn_relative_to_l2.note: Real-slot Jaccard is low overall (mean 0.2061), but the unrepaired challenges have the highest mean Jaccard (0.3108) and the unchanged-correct group the lowest (0.1749), so churn alone does not order the outcomes.

unsigned_absolute_gradient_mass.note: The Oracle retains more recorded absolute |grad*activation| mass than corrected L2 in every sample, yet still regresses 3 controls; the observed failure groups have a lower mean advantage. Because the score is unsigned and K96 pruning is nonlinear and discrete, retaining more absolute mass does not by itself imply the correct-answer margin survives. This is a plausible but untested mechanism.

context_anchor_rule_interaction.note: Per-slot scores are not stored for either arm and there is no context-reservation / anchor ablation arm in this pilot, so the context/anchor rule interaction cannot be isolated from the frozen records. Context-representative overlap is measurable and reported, but it is descriptive only.

decision_boundary.note: The direct absolute-gradient full-replacement teacher remains stopped and the preregistered STOP is not overturned. If (and only if) the next step is a bounded, conservative residual re-ranking on the corrected-L2 backbone, it is proposed here solely as an unproven, falsifiable hypothesis; no numeric mixture, threshold, K or anchor is specified or tuned on these 24 samples.

can_conclude: the frozen pilot decision is PILOT_STOP (10/12 repairs, 3/12 control regressions, parse 24/24, exact K96/87+9 layout 24/24) and every frozen input hash, record hash, id, transition label and layout verified

the direct absolute-gradient full-replacement teacher repaired 10/12 challenges but produced 3/12 control regressions and left 2/12 challenges unrepaired, so full replacement fails the preregistered control-regression gate

Oracle and corrected L2 select largely different slots (mean real-slot Jaccard 0.2061); the Oracle retains a larger fraction of its recorded absolute gradient saliency mass on the real slots (mean paired advantage 0.3136)
the observed associations between margin/G/Jaccard/retained-mass advantage and the signed transition outcome are exploratory only at n=24 with an outcome-enriched manifest
cannot_conclude: any official CV-Bench accuracy, deployability, FPGA/latency/speedup or representative-sampling statement
a causal mechanism for the 3 regressions or the 2 unrepaired challenges; n=24 outcome-enriched samples cannot support it
that a lower dense answer margin alone explains the failures (the unrepaired challenge includes a 7.5-margin sample)
that excessive selection churn relative to L2 explains the failures (the unrepaired challenges have the highest real-slot Jaccard)

that the unsigned absolute |grad*activation| signal preserves the correct-answer margin after the nonlinear discrete K96 pruning; the pilot only records retained saliency mass, not a margin after pruning
that the context/anchor reservation rule causes any observed difference; the per-slot scores are not recorded and no context/anchor ablation arm exists in this pilot
any tuned numeric mixture, threshold, K or anchor change on these 24 samples
scope: CPU-only, read-only postmortem of the frozen preregistered STOP; no GPU/model weights/network/training and no threshold/K/anchor tuning
